comparison.objective: Transfer a sterile device cord across a field boundary, route it through a holder, and insert its connector into a console; candidate commissions and mechanically locks an adjustable robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-756 emphasizes bimanual handoff, articulated-cord management, connector alignment/insertion, release, and contamination-zone avoidance. Candidate emphasizes hex-bit seating and withdrawal/re-engagement, captive-setscrew loosening, counterheld collar rotation, torque-limited locking, and iterative impact-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: PR-756 requires cord placement and at least 15 mm connector insertion within axis/alignment tolerances while satisfying persistent sterility constraints. Candidate requires two repeatable in-envelope stopping cycles with no bottoming, hard-stop strike, overload, excessive rebound, drift, damage, or energized adjustment.
comparison.reason: Hex-key insertion is only a shared generic primitive. The record tests deformable routing, sterile handoff, and connector seating; it does not test adjustable damping, lock retention, or dynamic stopping behavior.
